explanation: The proposed split between your two helpers. They don't pass work to each other: you pick one with the pop-up switch. Leaves out the screens (mockups coming).

columns.title: Assistant (all projects)
items: Sees and acts on every project's threads
Runs on the hub, no project files

columns.title: Project lead (one per project)
items: Pinned at the top of each project
Sees and acts only on that project's threads; the app refuses anything else
Runs on the project's machine with a read-only copy of its code, plans and history
Starts when you first write to it
Pop-up opens it on that project's pages, with a switch to the assistant
